nodes.summary: For natural numbers $y$ and $q$, $E^{\ast}(y; q)$ is the maximum of the residue-class error $E(y; q, a)$ over the natural numbers $a < q$ coprime to $q$, and $0$ if there is no such $a$.
nodes.title: Maximal residue-class error

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $x$ and $q$, $E^{\ast\ast}(x; q)$ is the maximum of the maximal residue-class error $E^{\ast}(y; q)$ over the natural numbers $y \le x$.
nodes.title: Maximal residue-class error up to a level

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $y$, $q$ and $a$, the residue-class error is $E(y; q, a) = \left|\psi(y; q, a) - y/\varphi(q)\right|$, where $\psi(y; q, a)$ is Chebyshev's function in the residue class of $a$ modulo $q$ and $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function.
nodes.title: Residue-class error of Chebyshev's function

nodes.summary: For a natural number $x$ and a real number $A$, the Bombieri–Vinogradov sum $S(x, A)$ is the sum of the maximal residue-class error $E^{\ast\ast}(x; q)$ up to $x$ over the integers $q$ with $1 \le q \le x$ and $q \le \sqrt{x} / (\log x)^{A + 5}$.
nodes.title: Bombieri–Vinogradov sum

nodes.summary: Let $\psi(y; q, a)$ denote Chebyshev's function in the residue class of $a$ modulo $q$, and let $\varphi$ be Euler's totient function. For a natural number $x$ and a real number $A$, let $S(x, A)$ be the sum, over the integers $q$ with $1 \le q \le x$ and $q \le \sqrt{x} / (\log x)^{A + 5}$, of the maximum of $\left|\psi(y; q, a) - y/\varphi(q)\right|$ over the natural numbers $y \le x$ and $a < q$ coprime to $q$.…
nodes.title: Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
